t: What he said putting on something new
a: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
p: Allāhumma laka-l-ḥamd, anta kasawtanīh. Asʾaluka min khayrihi wa khayri mā ṣuniʿa lah, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri mā ṣuniʿa lah
m: O Allah, praise belongs to You. You clothed me in it. I ask You for its good and the good of what it was made for, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of what it was made for.
